'''

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox
from script_generator import create_rsync_script, create_tar_script
class BackupScriptCreator:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Backup Script Creator")
        self.sources = []
        self.target = ""
        self.create_widgets()
        self.root.mainloop()
    def create_widgets(self):
        self.source_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Select Source Directories", command=self.select_source_directory)

        self.generate_button.pack(pady=5)
        self.generate_tar_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Generate Tar Script", command=lambda: self.generate_script('tar'))
        self.generate_tar_button.pack(pady=5)
    def select_source_directory(self):
        directory = filedialog.askdirectory()
        if directory:  # Only add if a directory was selected
            self.sources.append(directory)
            messagebox.showinfo("Source Directory Added", f"Added: {directory}")
    def select_target_directory(self):
        directory = filedialog.askdirectory()
        if directory:  # Only set if a directory was selected
            self.target = directory
            messagebox.showinfo("Target Directory Selected", f"Target: {directory}")
    def generate_script(self, method):
        if not self.sources or not self.target:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Please select source and target directories.")
            return
        if method == 'rsync':
            script_content = create_rsync_script(self.sources, self.target)
        elif method == 'tar':
            script_content = create_tar_script(self.sources, self.target)
        self.save_script(script_content)
    def save_script(self, script_content):
        file_path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension=".sh", filetypes=[("Shell Script", "*.sh")])
        if file_path:
            with open(file_path, 'w') as script_file:
                script_file.write(script_content)
            messagebox.showinfo("Success", f"Script saved to {file_path}")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    BackupScriptCreator()

'''
Contains functions to generate backup scripts using rsync and tar.
'''
def create_rsync_script(sources, target):
    script_lines = ["#!/bin/bash\n"]
    for source in sources:
        script_lines.append(f"rsync -av --progress {source} {target}\n")
    return ''.join(script_lines)
def create_tar_script(sources, target):
    script_lines = ["#!/bin/bash\n"]
    for source in sources:
        source_name = source.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
        script_lines.append(f"tar -cvf {target}/{source_name}.tar {source}\n")
    return ''.join(script_lines)
```
